'''Phelar''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]]. It was home to a large [[Phelar Port/Legends|spaceport]].

The [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] dispatched a squadron of [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Jedi starfighters]] to Phelar Port just before the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
